**Company Overview**
Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. What you'll do
  
  
As a Software Engineer Intern on the Signing Core Backend (SCORE) team, you will help re-architect Docusign's eSign branding capability into a centralized microservice that high-value customers rely on to deliver a consistent brand experience across the Docusign ecosystem. You will work with RESTful and gRPC interfaces so customers can define their brand identity once and reuse it across multiple Docusign products and features, including validating branding configurations before they are applied to accounts. You'll contribute to moving branding compute into a dedicated Azure-hosted service, improving reuse, iteration speed, and support for new enhancements in our Tier-0 branding platform.
  
  
This is an internship role for 12 weeks of duration. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Collaborate with the SCORE team to design and implement a centralized branding microservice that powers cross-product brand consistency for eSign and related experiences
* Build and evolve RESTful and gRPC APIs that allow customers and internal services to define, retrieve, validate, and apply branding configurations in a consistent way
* Help migrate branding compute from legacy components into a dedicated Azure-based service, leveraging MSF patterns and standards for reliability and scalability
* Work on features that improve branding validation, so customers can preview and verify their brand setup before it is applied to production accounts, reducing misconfiguration risk
* Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure branding APIs and workflows are robust, observable, and safe for Tier-0 production use
* Partner with adjacent product and engineering teams that consume branding data (e.g., other signing surfaces and services) to support reuse and consistent experiences across products
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and sprint ceremonies; incorporate feedback from your mentor and teammates to grow your engineering skills
